cc:Work.dc:title: Keep individual stress misses visible
cc:Work.dc:description: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL • Origin day 60 → day 180 • Each row is one source/cohort/world forecast Intervals are predictive at the individual-forecast grain, not uncertainty around scenario-average margins. Truth diamonds use evaluator-only complete economic outcomes. Common dollar scale; all selected seeds and sources are retained.
